_comment: Containment guard for the Claude Code arm, passed with --settings so it lives OUTSIDE the folder the agent can edit. It is the translation of experiments/opencode.json's permission block into Claude Code's vocabulary; the two files must be read side by side, because keeping the two arms' freedoms equal is the point. Claude Code confines file tools to the working directory by default, so the run folder needs no allow rule and every other run folder is gated automatically -- that is what bnbcode expresses as external_directory deny-by-default. The absolute deny rules below are the extra, unconditional layer: the experiment's own materials, other people's keys, the shared venvs. Like bnbcode's bash deny list, the Bash rules here are a guardrail against an accident, NOT a sandbox: Bash is not path-gated in either harness and python -c reaches the same effect. If you want real confinement, use local_model/run_guard_marvin_sandbox.json's bubblewrap approach instead.

permissions._comment: acceptEdits + an explicit Bash allow is what makes the run unattended. Plain acceptEdits auto-accepts edits but still prompts on every Bash call (measured on Marvin 2026-08-27), which is the same dead end the bnbcode arm hit before its permission block existed. defaultMode is deliberately NOT bypassPermissions: that skips the checks these deny rules are made of.
